name: portaloub-studio
description: Portfolio interactivo de PortalOub - Next.js + Nest.js + arquitectura limpia

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @portaloub/api" "npm run dev --workspace @portaloub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @portaloub/api && npm run build --workspace @portaloub/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --workspace @portaloub/api" "npm run start --workspace @portaloub/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @portaloub/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @portaloub/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @portaloub/web
